title: Excellent - Vintage 1988 Donruss Tom Prince Pittsburgh Pirates Rookie Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a vintage 1988 Donruss Tom Prince Pittsburgh Pirates rookie card. The card features an original MLB player, Tom Prince, in his rookie season with the Pittsburgh Pirates. It is part of the 1988 Donruss set and is made of card stock. This baseball trading card is in standard size and is a licensed original reprint.
